common_kit.role: Reusable surfaces, props, overlays, and masks. Puzzle assets may override it.

matrix_skin.surface_policy: Seven offset gallery regions are clipped from the puzzle matrix; midnight-gallery-v1 only supplies flat hand-drawn surfaces.
matrix_skin.object_policy: All common object-kit/v3 overlays come from one shared style master and use generated render_box and footprint; they never change puzzle facts.

background.usage: asset is optional page atmosphere; board_asset is deterministic programmatic board rendering; board logic remains cell driven
